title: Critical Invariants - System Properties That Must Always Hold

invariants.name: No Cascade Failures
invariants.description: Module failures must not cascade to other modules
invariants.condition: For each module M, failure of M does not propagate to other modules
invariants.mechanism: Module isolation, error boundaries, event isolation

invariants.name: Type Safety
invariants.description: All events and service calls must be type-safe
invariants.condition: Every event conforms to its schema, every service call has valid parameters

invariants.name: Permission Enforcement
invariants.description: Authorization checks must be enforced on all protected resources
invariants.condition: Every endpoint and service method checks user permissions before executing
invariants.mechanism: RBAC gates, permission matrix, access control lists
invariants.validation_method: Audit log verification, permission check sampling

invariants.name: Event Propagation Guarantee
invariants.description: All emitted events must be delivered to registered listeners
invariants.condition: For each event emission, all registered listeners are called
invariants.mechanism: EventBus queueing, retry logic, dead-letter queue
invariants.validation_method: Event delivery tracking, listener execution verification

invariants.name: State Machine Correctness
invariants.description: Bootstrap must follow correct state transitions with guard enforcement
invariants.condition: State transitions follow defined rules, guards are evaluated, side-effects executed
invariants.mechanism: State machine with guards, side-effects, history tracking
invariants.validation_method: State transition verification, guard evaluation checks

invariants.name: Data Consistency
invariants.description: Cache and database must remain synchronized
invariants.condition: For each cached value, cache entry == database entry OR cache is invalidated
invariants.mechanism: Write-through cache, cache invalidation on writes, periodic validation
invariants.validation_method: Spot checks of cache vs database, invalidation tracking

invariants.name: Module Isolation
invariants.description: Modules must not share mutable state
invariants.condition: No shared mutable state between modules, only communication through events/services
invariants.mechanism: DI container boundaries, immutable service contracts

invariants.name: Service Availability
invariants.description: All critical services must remain injectable through DI container
invariants.condition: For each service, di.get(service) returns valid instance without timeout
invariants.mechanism: DI container lifecycle management, service registration verification
invariants.validation_method: DI resolution checks, service ping tests

procedures: Emit critical alert to observability stack
Exit with code 1 if recovery fails
